boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Saint Michael’s settings with documented study, writing, project, or academic-event uses.

cards.title: Children’s Collection Room
cards.subtitle: Durick Library · second floor
cards.notes: Bring independent reading or a small-group task to this second-floor room, then use its spacious, quieter setup for a focused work block.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor Durick Library room with children’s books and documented space for individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies the Children’s Collection Room on Durick Library’s second floor as a quiet, spacious place for focused individual or group work.
cards.source_title: A roundup of St. Mike’s study spots | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Confirm library access and any room-use guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Durick Library Room 222 · main floor
cards.notes: Take your assignment, draft, and laptop to Room 222; drop in during posted hours or schedule a session when you want writing feedback.
cards.short_summary: A bright main-floor writing space with trained student coaches and a huddle-space monitor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center is in Durick Library Room 222 and welcomes students to use the space for focus or to work with student writing coaches.
cards.access_notes: Walk-in availability is posted for Sunday through Thursday during the semester; appointments can also be scheduled online.

cards.entity_name: Center for Student Diversity, Empowerment, and Community (DEC)
cards.title: DEC Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Alliot Student Center · Center for Student Diversity, Empowerment, and Community
cards.notes: Use a DEC study room for a planned session, and keep your work portable so the surrounding center can continue serving student programs.
cards.short_summary: DEC combines a student-activity hub with couches and multiple study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s describes the DEC in Alliot as a student-activity hub with couches and various study rooms used for studying.
cards.source_title: A roundup of St. Mike’s study spots | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: The DEC is in Alliot Student Center; room access may be affected by center programming.

cards.title: Dion First-Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Dion Family Student Center · first floor
cards.notes: Set up with class materials in Dion’s first-floor study area, keeping food and drinks separate from your work so you can pack up easily.
cards.short_summary: An active student-center study area near the Makerspace and Einstein Bros. Bagels.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies a study area on the first floor of the Dion Family Student Center, near the Makerspace and Einstein Bros. Bagels.
cards.source_title: A roundup of St. Mike’s study spots | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: This is a shared student-center area; availability can change with campus events and daily activity.

cards.title: Dion Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Dion Family Student Center · project-work setting
cards.notes: Bring a defined making or design task, then check current access instructions before using equipment or settling in for project planning.
cards.short_summary: A named Dion Center creative workspace used for hands-on College programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s lists the Makerspace as a named space in the Dion Center for creative programming.
cards.source_title: 2025 MLK Convocation Program | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Equipment use and access may be supervised or program-specific; verify current Makerspace rules before arrival.

cards.title: Roy Room
cards.subtitle: Dion Family Student Center · event and presentation room
cards.notes: Check the events calendar before planning a group work session here, and use the room only when it is open and not reserved.
cards.short_summary: A named Dion Family Student Center room that hosts research presentations and academic programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies the Roy Room in the Dion Family Student Center as a venue for academic presentations and research events.
cards.source_title: How a House Becomes a Home | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: This is an event venue, so it may be booked or closed to drop-in use; confirm availability first.

cards.title: Archway Lounge
cards.subtitle: Dion Center · lounge setting
cards.notes: Use this lounge for portable reading or planning between commitments, and yield the space when a scheduled student program is underway.
cards.short_summary: A named Dion Center lounge that serves as a gathering space for College programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies Archway Lounge as a named space in the Dion Center used for College programming.
cards.source_title: 2025 MLK Convocation Program | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Lounge availability depends on student-center events; do not use it during scheduled programming unless the event is open.

cards.title: Alliot First Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alliot Student Center · first-floor lounge
cards.notes: Bring a compact task for a lounge-based study break, then check posted programs before relying on the room for a longer session.
cards.short_summary: A named Alliot Student Center lounge documented as a College-program venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies the First Floor Lounge in Alliot as a named location for College programming.
cards.source_title: 2025 MLK Convocation Program | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: This shared lounge may be occupied for events or activities; check on-site signage before settling in.

cards.title: Eddies Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alliot Student Center · lounge setting
cards.notes: Use Eddies Lounge for reading or group planning when no event is scheduled, and keep the shared lounge clear for its programmed activities.
cards.short_summary: A named Alliot lounge that hosts College discussions and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies Eddies Lounge in Alliot as a venue for College discussion programming.
cards.source_title: International Education Week 2025 Poster | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: Availability is event-dependent; confirm the lounge is not reserved before using it for study.

cards.title: Farrell Room
cards.subtitle: St. Edmund’s Hall · academic-event room
cards.notes: Check whether the room is open before bringing a small group, then use its academic-event setting for discussion, review, or presentation practice.
cards.short_summary: A named St. Edmund’s Hall room used for lectures, panels, and other academic programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies the Farrell Room in St. Edmund’s Hall as a venue for lectures, workshops, and student panels.
cards.source_title: International Education Week 2025 Poster | Saint Michael's College
cards.access_notes: The room is used for scheduled academic events and may not be open for drop-in study; verify access before visiting.
